# Tickets

> Open-source agile ticket tracker built with Laravel. Includes a Kanban board, knowledge base, real-time collaboration, and a REST API.

AI agents can interact with Tickets through its REST API or its MCP server, both using Bearer token authentication.

## Base URL

`/api/v1`: All endpoints require `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN`

## Authentication

Generate a token from the user profile page (`/user/api-token`). All API requests require the Bearer token in the Authorization header.

## Endpoints

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|--------|----------|-------------|
| GET | `/api/v1/health` | Health check: returns `{"status": "ok"}` |
| GET | `/api/v1/lookups` | Returns statuses, types, importance levels, projects, milestones, releases, and users with IDs |
| GET | `/api/v1/kb/lookups` | Returns KB categories and tags with IDs |
| GET | `/api/v1/kb/articles` | List KB articles: supports `query`, `category_id`, `status`, `tag_id` |
| POST | `/api/v1/kb/articles` | Create KB article: requires `title`, `body_markdown`, `category_id`, `tags` |
| GET | `/api/v1/kb/articles/{id}` | Get KB article by id or slug |
| PUT/PATCH | `/api/v1/kb/articles/{id}` | Update KB article |
| GET | `/api/v1/tickets` | List tickets: supports `status`, `unassigned`, `decision` (`me`/`any`), `pulse` query params. Rows carry `decision_needed` and `decision_needed_from` |
| POST | `/api/v1/tickets` | Create ticket: requires `subject`; optional `description`, `type_id`, `importance_id`, `project_id`, `milestone_id`, `due_at`, `estimate`, `storypoints` |
| GET | `/api/v1/tickets/{id}` | Get ticket detail with notes, reactions, replies, attachments |
| PUT/PATCH | `/api/v1/tickets/{id}` | Update ticket |
| POST | `/api/v1/tickets/{id}/note` | Add note: supports `body`, `status_id`, `hours`, `claim`. Body supports slash commands: `/decision`, `/decide @user`, `/blocker`, `/action`, `/assign`, `/status`, `/hours`, `/estimate`, `/close`, `/reopen`. Mentions notify, and field changes are written to the changelog |
| POST | `/api/v1/tickets/{id}/notes/{id}/react` | Toggle emoji reaction on a note: pass `emoji` param |
| POST | `/api/v1/tickets/{id}/notes/{id}/reply` | Reply to a note. A body starting `/decision` records a decision and closes a decision request thread |
| PUT | `/api/v1/tickets/{id}/notes/{id}` | Edit a note |
| POST | `/api/v1/tickets/{id}/notes/{id}/resolve` | Resolve a thread: requires `resolution_message` |
| POST | `/api/v1/tickets/{id}/notes/{id}/moderate` | Moderate a note |
| POST | `/api/v1/tickets/{id}/notes/{id}/promote` | Promote a note: `type` is `decision`, `blocker`, `action`, or `decision_needed` (with `assignee` as the decider) |
| POST | `/api/v1/tickets/{id}/watch` | Watch a ticket |
| GET | `/api/v1/tickets/{id}/pulse` | Returns execution state (ON TRACK, AT RISK, BLOCKED, IDLE), latest blocker, next action, latest decision, open threads, decision requests |

## MCP server

`POST /mcp/tickets` (same Bearer token) or stdio handle `tickets`. Tools:

- `get-lookups-tool`, `list-tickets-tool`, `search-tickets-tool`, `get-ticket-tool`, `get-pulse-tool`, `create-ticket-tool`, `update-ticket-tool`
- `list-milestones-tool`, `get-milestone-tool`, `create-milestone-tool`, `update-milestone-tool`
- `add-note-tool`, `reply-to-note-tool`, `edit-note-tool`, `resolve-note-tool`, `react-to-note-tool`, `moderate-note-tool`, `promote-note-tool`, `watch-ticket-tool`
- `get-kb-lookups-tool`, `kb-search-tool`, `get-kb-article-tool`, `create-kb-article-tool`, `update-kb-article-tool`

Prompts: `triage-ticket-prompt`, `standup-digest-prompt`, `close-out-ticket-prompt`.

## Key Concepts

- **lookups-first**: Always call `/lookups` (or `get-lookups-tool`) to get valid IDs before creating/updating tickets
- **pulse-before-act**: Check pulse before acting: a BLOCKED ticket needs unblocking, not more status updates
- **Slash commands**: Use `/blocker`, `/decision`, `/action` in note body to add structured signals that surface in pulse data
- **Decision requests**: `/decide @user question` asks one person to decide and notifies them at once. Open requests surface in pulse `decision_requests` and `list-tickets-tool` with `decision: "me"`. Reply on the thread with `/decision <text>` to close it
- **rate limit**: API and MCP share a 60 requests per minute throttle; back off and retry on 429

## Sandbox

`php artisan db:seed --class=DemoSeeder` builds a Demo Sandbox project with tickets, notes, and a milestone. Mutate it freely; never touch real user data while exploring. The demo login seeds on local and testing environments only.

## Web Features (Non-API)

- CSV import: Navigate to `/tickets/import` in the UI (requires existing projects).
- Kanban board: `/tickets/board`
- Knowledge base: `/kb`
